name: API Isarud Trade Compliance
author: Seçkin Sefa Durası

sections.description:
API Isarud Trade Compliance is the most comprehensive free WooCommerce plugin for sanctions screening and multi-marketplace integration.

🛡️ Sanctions Screening

Screen customers and companies against 32,500+ sanctioned entities from 8 global lists: OFAC SDN, OFAC Consolidated, EU, UN, UK HMT, Canada SEMA, Australia DFAT, and World Bank. Fuzzy matching with configurable threshold and full audit trail.

🏪 6 Marketplace Integrations

Connect your WooCommerce store to Trendyol, Hepsiburada, N11, Amazon SP-API, Pazarama, and Etsy. Two-way stock sync, price sync, product upload/import, order management, and more.

📦 Full Trendyol Integration

  • Stock and price synchronization
  • Product upload (WC → Trendyol) and import (Trendyol → WC)
  • Order import and auto status sync (Picking/Shipped/Cancelled)
  • Cargo company assignment
  • Return/claim management (approve/reject)
  • Invoice link sending (auto + manual)
  • Customer questions (view + answer from WP admin)
  • Brand search + category tree + required attributes

📦 Hepsiburada Integration

  • Stock and price synchronization
  • Product upload and import
  • Order import and status sync
  • Return/claim management
  • Invoice link sending

📦 N11 Integration

  • Stock and price synchronization (SOAP API)
  • Product upload and import
  • Order import and status sync
  • Webhook support

📊 Statistics & Activity Dashboard

  • WP Dashboard widget with real-time statistics
  • Last 24 hours activity timeline on Isarud Dashboard
  • Dedicated Statistics page with period filtering (1 Hour / 24 Hours / 7 Days / 30 Days / All)
  • Detailed activity log with screening and sync history (up to 100 records)

🔄 Order Management

WooCommerce order status changes are automatically synced to connected marketplaces. Assign shipping companies and track orders across platforms.

🔁 Returns & Invoices

Fetch return requests from Trendyol and Hepsiburada, approve or reject from WP admin. Send invoice links automatically when orders complete.

💬 Customer Questions

View and answer Trendyol customer questions directly from WordPress admin. Filter by status (waiting/answered).

🏷️ Brand & Category Lookup

Search Trendyol brand database, browse full category tree, and get required attributes for product upload.

🎨 Modern Admin Interface

Brand-colored gradient cards for each marketplace with feature indicators, accordion layout, and 16+ admin pages including Dashboard, Statistics, Returns, Customer Questions, and more.

☁️ Cloud Sync

Sync your WooCommerce data to your isarud.com account. Access your products, orders and screening results from web, mobile and desktop apps.

Additional Features

  • CSV import/export (Excel compatible, UTF-8 BOM)
  • Variation sync (size, color)
  • Category and attribute mapping
  • Dropshipping (supplier management + auto order forwarding)
  • Affiliate (referral codes + commission tracking)
  • HPOS compatible (High-Performance Order Storage)
  • Turkish + English i18n with complete .po/.mo files
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/api-isarud/ or install directly from WordPress.org
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Isarud → Dashboard for the getting started guide
  4. Enter your marketplace API credentials in Isarud → Pazar Yeri API
  5. (Optional) Connect to isarud.com via Isarud → Cloud Sync
  6. (Optional) Set up webhooks in Isarud → Webhooks for two-way stock sync
sections.faq:
Is this plugin really free?

Yes. 100% free with no premium version, no feature limits, and no hidden costs.

Which marketplaces are supported?

Trendyol, Hepsiburada, N11, Amazon SP-API, Pazarama, and Etsy.

Do I need a marketplace seller account?

Yes. You need active seller accounts on the marketplaces you want to connect. API credentials are obtained from each marketplace’s seller panel.

Is WooCommerce required?

WooCommerce is required for marketplace features. Sanctions screening works without WooCommerce.

How does two-way stock sync work?

When a sale occurs on a marketplace, the webhook notifies your WordPress site and WooCommerce stock is automatically updated. When WooCommerce stock changes, it syncs back to the marketplace via WP Cron (configurable: 15min / 1hr / 6hr / daily).

Can I manage Trendyol returns from WordPress?

Yes. The Returns page lets you fetch, approve, and reject return/claim requests from Trendyol and Hepsiburada directly in WP admin.

Does it support product variations?

Yes. Size and color variations are synced between WooCommerce and marketplaces.

Where can I get support?

Visit isarud.com or open an issue on GitHub.
